author: Coco_stag
body:
As in team I don't mean blue or red. I mean Berzerk or Powerpuff Boys.

Honestly, it takes forever to message your whole team. I need to tell them we are scrimming but some are in nebula, walls and nexus! Please add this in. It would make it easier to tell your whole team something. This will only message the people online

Input command
/msgteam Hi Team We are scrimming

Output message
Team sees message you sent in the normal msg prefix/design
